paragraphs: Rav Yosef bar Chama, Rava’s father—meaning Rav Yosef, Rava’s father: Eruvin 54a. Rabbi Abba sent to him: Bava Batra 127b, Yesh Nochalin [printed chapter locator: פי״ג]. Rabbi Oshaya said: Bava Kamma 112b. They say in the West: Rabbi Yose—it seems to me it should read Rav Yosef—bar Chama and Rabbi Zeira dispute; some say Rava son of Rav Yosef bar Chama and Rabbi Zeira, Beitzah 8b. Rabbi Yochanan said: Gittin 39b. Rabbi Nachman said: there, 43b. Rabbi Sheshet said: Avodah Zarah 26b, Shabbat 63a, and Eizehu Neshekh 70a: ‘Rabbah son of Rabbi Yosef bar Chama said: Rav Sheshet said.’ Rosh and Rif omit Rabbah. He spoke to Rav Sheshet there, 72b. Rav Assi—it seems to me it should read Rav Yosef—bar Chama told Rava: ‘Thus said Rav Sheshet,’ end of HaChovel 93a. He raised a contradiction to Rava: Bava Metzia 58a. Rami bar Chama disputes with him: Gittin 39b. Half a parasang from the town of Malluach is the grave of Chananyah, Mishael, and Azaryah. From there to Ein Tzinah are buried Rav Pappa, Rav Huna, Rav Yosef Sinai, and Rav Yosef bar Chama (גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael]).
